form.auto_tenant_description: This plugin accepts enrollment, so it can store the secret itself instead of you editing its TENANTS KV. Connect sends a single-use ticket; the plugin redeems it against this CMS's canonical origin and only then receives the secret.
form.connect_no_origin: Set CANONICAL_ORIGIN on this CMS first: the plugin verifies enrollment by calling that origin back.
form.connect_no_secret: This plugin has no dedicated secret yet — rotate to assign one, then connect.
form.connect_not_supported: This plugin does not accept automatic enrollment. Copy the tenant KV record below by hand.
form.connect_ok: Connected. The plugin registered this CMS as a tenant.
form.connect_rejected: The plugin refused the enrollment. Check its logs — its allowlist or tenant limit may block it.
form.connect_unreachable: The plugin could not be reached. Check that it is enabled and its URL is correct.
form.disconnect_confirm: Remove this CMS from the plugin's tenant list? The plugin stops accepting our calls until it is connected again.
form.disconnect_ok: Disconnected. The plugin removed this CMS from its tenants.
form.disconnect_rejected: The plugin refused to remove this CMS. Check its logs.
form.no_dedicated_secret: This plugin has no dedicated secret yet and is using the shared
form.registered_flash: Plugin registered. Copy the secret below onto the plugin Worker.
form.rotate_connect_failed: Secret rotated, but the plugin did not accept the new value. Press Connect to retry, or update it by hand.
form.rotate_connect_ok: Secret rotated and pushed to the plugin.
form.rotate_to_assign: fallback — rotate to assign its own.
form.rotated_flash: Secret rotated. Update the plugin Worker to the new value — the old one no longer works.

identity.approved: Identity approved. Re-grant the plugin's approvals as needed.
identity.claimed_flash: That manifest id belongs to another registered plugin.
identity.claimed_help: Another registered plugin already owns this manifest id, so this one stays offline:
identity.confirm: Approve the new identity? This plugin's asset, page type and file prefix approvals will be revoked.
identity.mismatch_help: This plugin now reports a different manifest id than the one it was approved with. It stays offline until you approve the change, because its approvals, stored data and admin access all follow the manifest id. Approving revokes its asset, page type and file prefix approvals — grant them again once you are sure this is the same plugin.
identity.title: Plugin identity needs approval
identity.unreachable_flash: The plugin did not return a manifest, so its identity cannot be approved.
